_comment: Regression gates for evaluation/scripts/ci_gate.py. These are floors/ceilings set at or just below the measured baselines (MODEL_STATUS.md, 2026-09-04) - they block regressions, they are not quality targets. backend = datasets/gold/eval_gold_pipeline.py (refined_prediction, 308 gold samples). js = frontend/scripts/eval-gold-js.mjs (JS pipeline, same gold set).
_comment_backend: backend baseline: accuracy 0.8084, recall 0.7722, fpr 0.1406 (MODEL_STATUS.md Phase 1.5). Thresholds sit just below each value so normal variance passes and any drop below the baseline fails.
_comment_js: js baseline: accuracy 0.8344, recall 0.8167, fpr 0.1406 (MODEL_STATUS.md Tier 1 FN-gap tuning, 2026-09-04).
